name: openclaw-syncralis
description: An industry-grade file sharing, secure download, and load-balanced gateway designed for high-availability OpenClaw environments.

FILE_SERVER_PORT.description: The port on which the Syncralis gateway will listen.

WORKSPACE_DIR.description: Absolute path to the directory being served. Must be reachable by the service.

FILE_SERVER_HOST.description: The host interface to bind the gateway to.

TAVILY_API_KEY.description: API key for Tavily web search integration.

BRAVE_API_KEY.description: API key for Brave web search integration.

PUBLIC_TUNNEL_URL.description: The public URL generated by the Ngrok tunnel.

NGROK_TOKEN.description: Authentication token for the Ngrok service.

REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS.description: Timeout duration in milliseconds for gateway requests.

MAX_QUERY_LENGTH.description: Maximum allowed character length for search queries.
